title: The sweep's keep check does not count a lane branch as proof that work is pushed
why: janitor/sweep.py (line 741) keeps a worktree unless HEAD is on a remote-tracking ref, read with `git branch -r --contains HEAD`. That also matches lane branches, the same bug #1777 fixed in the roadmap refusal. Reported by lane roadmap-push-refusal-says-fetch (coordinator, 22:45 CST Nov 7).
note: Unchecked: first check whether a lane-branch match lets the sweep remove work that is not on main or an archive. If it does, a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). Done check: a red test where HEAD is only on a lane branch. Slug and title by triage; no source gave one. A queue-fix lane under the item 384 hold.
